cardOverview.overviewText: An entry-level business card providing rewards on everyday categories like travel, dining, and utilities, tailored for startups and small business owners.

benefitRows.name: Dining
benefitRows.offer: Up to 20% discount on partner restaurants via Dineout when using your HDFC Bank Credit Card.
benefitRows.howToAvail: To avail this benefit, log in to the Swiggy or Dineout app or website using your registered account. Browse the available dining and order-in offers, select your favorite meals or restaurants, and apply the offer at checkout. Complete the payment using your HDFC Biz First credit card.

benefitRows.name: Insurance
benefitRows.offer: Fire and burglary insurance for shops up to ₹5 lakh.|Cash in safe/transit cover up to ₹25,000.|Electronic equipment insurance (excluding terrorism) up to ₹50,000.|Hospital cash (accident-only) payable per day up to ₹1,000.|Hospital cash (illness-only) payable per day up to ₹1,000.
benefitRows.howToAvail: Contact at 1800-266-9777 or schedule a call. You can also send a missed call to +91-9980970424 or email buyonline@hdfclife.in.
